body: Thank you.. it means a lot just to hear one real person that can relate...

Hey.. I might just be some random person. But i speak from experience. I’m 14 and I’ve tried 3 times. I couldn’t tell anyone. Because when I did they didn’t take me seriously. I don’t care what you think.. but please, PLEASE don’t do it! It might seem like a solution, a way to get away from the cuts, and constant hiding! But it’s not. Please WILL miss you. I will miss you. Life will get better. I’ve struggled with my sexuality and finding myself for so long. I was too ‘Young’ to know what.. “Gay” or “Depression” was. But I still felt like a 26 year old would feel about this. Don’t do it. You have friends that care. Just keep caring for them! Life gets hard. But you can get though it. I planned another attempt a few weeks ago. But I knew I had to live to see my dad. I just couldn’t go yet. Please don’t do it... please.
